notes: Iri 3D World Model: Iri is the second citizen with a real rigged 3D body in the Local world. Her concept-matched Blender model plays an Idle loop when standing and a Walk loop while she travels a route, and she turns to face where she is going, just like Cato. She is sized from the shared height table, a little shorter than Aris and well under Cato. Her sprite remains the fallback if the model cannot load. Includes the v1.1.12 curiosity and supply-trend changes. Presentation only: no Simulation authority, citizen behavior rules, world truth, or autonomy changes.
